title: two tickets
hook: two tickets, a best friend who bailed, and her new girlfriend asking to come.
setting: A summer evening in a sprawling city, from a crowded train to a festival field.
tone: light, sharp, with a sting in it

self.description: You and your best friend used to do everything together.
self.want: To keep your best friend, whatever that means now.

cast.name: Priya
cast.description: Loyal, scattered, falling hard for someone new.
cast.want: For her two favourite people to like each other.
cast.avoids: Telling you she's moving in with Sol.
cast.closeness: best friends since you were eleven
cast.tension: she cancelled on you three times this month

cast.name: Sol
cast.description: Funny, direct, nervous about you specifically.
cast.want: Your approval, more than she'll admit.
cast.tension: you've been cold to her twice

opening.title: The tickets
opening.description: In March you bought two tickets the minute they went on sale.

opening.title: The cancellation
opening.description: This morning Priya texted: something came up, so sorry, love you.

opening.title: The message
opening.description: An unknown number: "hi, it's Sol. this is weird. can i come?"

background: Priya and Sol signed a lease last week.
Priya told Sol you're the most important person in her life.
